To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Max-min algorithm performs the best in terms of cost and makespan while the Min-min algorithm performs the worst in terms of cost but performs the best in term of degree of imbalance, throughput and makespan in the homogeneous environment.
FCFS is the best heuristic algorithm for scheduling tasks in homogeneous environment and Sufferage is the best algorithm for scheduling tasks of a heterogeneous environment.

the FCFS algorithm has the lowest makespan and throughput, but it is also the most expensive algorithm, while the Sufferage algorithm has the lowest degree of imbalance and cost but it also has the highest makespan and throughput.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance comparison and evaluation of heuristic algorithms for scheduling tasks in IaaS cloud environments.
performance comparison of heuristic algorithms in IaaS cloud environment.
comparing the performance of six rule based heuristic methods for scheduling autonomous tasks on virtual machines of cloud computing environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Max-min heuristic algorithm is more efficient than the other five heuristic algorithms considered.
the FCFS and MET algorithms perform better than the other four algorithms in terms of the four parameters considered for the performance analysis.
, Sufferage algorithm is the best algorithm for the task scheduling problem considered in this study, followed by Min-min and MCT.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the FCFS algorithm has the lowest makespan and the highest degree of imbalance, while the Min-min algorithm has the lowest degree of imbalance and the highest makespan.
FCFS algorithm is the best in terms of throughput, while Min-min algorithm is the best for cost and degree of imbalance.

the Max-min algorithm is the best for scheduling tasks with heterogeneous execution times, the FCFS algorithm is the worst for scheduling tasks with homogeneous execution times and the Sufferage algorithm is the best in terms of throughput.
The main takeaway from our work is that
FCFS and MCT algorithms are not appropriate for scheduling autonomous tasks in heterogeneous environments.
, the performance of the rule based algorithms are affected by the characteristics of the tasks and the environment, hence the need to choose an algorithm based on these characteristics.
the performance of the heuristic algorithms varies with the nature of the tasks and the cloud environment.
